newsitem.title: USA: U.S. economy slowed sharply in third quarter.
newsitem.headline: U.S. economy slowed sharply in third quarter.

text.p: The economy's third-quarter slowdown was slightly less abrupt than previously thought, the Commerce Department said Friday, mainly because production for inventory was stronger than estimated a month ago.

The nation's gross domestic product expanded at a 2.1 percent annual rate in the three months from July through September. That was still less than half the 4.7 percent pace posted during the second quarter but fractionally higher than the 2 percent rate estimated a month ago, the department said in its second and final look at third-quarter performance.
